import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Corresponding target column names for SalePrice from each source
    # According to target schema:
    # Source0 -> SalePrice_x
    # Source1 -> SalePrice_y
    # Source2 -> SalePrice_x_3
    # Source3 -> SalePrice_y_4
    # Source4 -> SalePrice_x_5
    # Source5 -> SalePrice_y_6
    # Source6 -> SalePrice_x_7
    # Source7 -> SalePrice_y_8
    # Source8 -> SalePrice_x_9
    # Source9 -> SalePrice_y_10
    target_price_columns = [
        "SalePrice_x",
        "SalePrice_y",
        "SalePrice_x_3",
        "SalePrice_y_4",
        "SalePrice_x_5",
        "SalePrice_y_6",
        "SalePrice_x_7",
        "SalePrice_y_8",
        "SalePrice_x_9",
        "SalePrice_y_10"
    ]

    # Load all sources into dataframes
    dfs = []
    for path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(path)
        # Ensure only 'Id' and 'SalePrice' columns are kept (in case of extra columns)
        df = df[['Id', 'SalePrice']]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Start merging on 'Id' from the first dataframe
    # Rename SalePrice columns to target column names before merging to avoid suffix issues
    dfs_renamed = []
    for i, df in enumerate(dfs):
        df_renamed = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": target_price_columns[i]})
        dfs_renamed.append(df_renamed)

    # Merge all dataframes on 'Id' using inner join to keep only common Ids
    # This matches the target table size (729 rows)
    merged_df = dfs_renamed[0]
    for df in dfs_renamed[1:]:
        merged_df = pd.merge(merged_df, df, on="Id", how="inner")

    # Ensure the column order matches the target schema
    target_columns = ['Id'] + target_price_columns
    merged_df = merged_df[target_columns]

    # Convert data types explicitly
    merged_df['Id'] = merged_df['Id'].astype(int)
    for col in target_price_columns:
        merged_df[col] = merged_df[col].astype(float)

    # Write the result to the target path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    merged_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
